purpose: Teach: チェルシー/太宰/アンパン/紀伊国屋/バロック/リアリズム/ホビー/マイカー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、チェルシーの試合観てたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you watching the Chelsea match.
lines.style: Casual accusation with a smirk underneath. Fast, direct. Slight challenge in the tone — testing him, playful. Eyes bright with catching him in something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語で太宰治の「走れメロス」習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied that Dazai story, 'Run, Melos' in Japanese class, didn't you?
lines.style: Turning the tables with a half-smile. Measured, deliberate. Matches her rhythm but coolly — showing he noticed her too. No heat, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アンパンマンの主題歌歌ってたな
lines.en: Riku, I heard you singing the Anpanman theme song.
lines.style: Dry, almost deadpan delivery. Slight laugh caught in the throat. Drawing out the moment before the punchline lands. Knows it's embarrassing and that's the point.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、紀伊国屋書店で参考書漁ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were digging through study guides at Kinokuniya the other day, weren't you?
lines.style: Matching her dryness but softer. Quick-paced. Subtle amusement — he's got her back. Not defensive, just even. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、音楽でバロック習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied Baroque music in class, right?
lines.style: Slight rise at the end — genuine curiosity now, not just teasing. Lighter, more open. Still testing but with less edge. Leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語でリアリズム文学習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered realism literature in Japanese class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, calm. The teasing has softened into something more conversational. Warm undertone. Acknowledging her name like he's including her in something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ホビーショップによく行ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you used to go to that hobby shop all the time.
lines.style: Observation more than accusation now. Softer tone, almost nostalgic. Slower pace. She's noticing things about him, genuinely. Less testing, more seeing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、マイカーで旅行行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your family went on road trips in your own car, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer now, quieter. The teasing has turned into something almost tender — he's remembering details about her. Warm, unhurried. Slight vulnerability in the soft ending.
